description: This file is a shell script designed to perform performance testing of git log commands related to file history and log features. It defines tests for log performance, involving selection of a random file and executing multiple git log commands under different options to measure their performance.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Initializes or sets up the default repository environment for testing.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a perf test with a specific description and command.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to succeed, with the given description and commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the testing script.
